title: Clean Quote
oneLiner: Instant house cleaning price quote builder for solo cleaners, shareable link
customer: Solo and small house cleaning businesses

evidence.claim: An Etsy listing sells a cleaning business spreadsheet bundle covering pricing and a client tracker.
QuotePro, a quoting and pricing platform built for residential and commercial cleaning businesses, starts at a flat 19 USD a month.
An Etsy cleaning business pricing calculator and quote template sells for about 8.20 USD; its shop SimplyPMA shows 940 sales and the listing 31 favorites.
Etsy search for cleaning price calculator returns several paid cleaning pricing and quote spreadsheets priced from 5 to 24 USD, one with 58 reviews.
QuoteIQ charges from 29.99 USD a month (Essentials, 1 user) with no free plan for its quoting and estimate software.
ZenMaid, maid service software, charges 19, 39 and 49 USD a month for its Starter, Pro and Pro Max plans.
Launch27 sells cleaning business booking forms that price jobs online at 75, 150 and 299 USD a month.

nextAction: Business case by research, sizing by sizing, then CEO go or no-go. Evidence for: paid quoting tools (QuotePro 19 USD/mo, QuoteIQ 29.99 USD/mo, ZenMaid 19 USD/mo, Launch27 75 USD/mo) and paid Etsy pricing calculators (SimplyPMA 940 shop sales). Evidence against: Jobber, Housecall Pro, Connecteam and ShiftFlow give free cleaning calculators and estimate templates, Jobber free for 5 quotes a month. Demand is real but mostly US, and the free gap is narrow.

evidenceAgainst.claim: Jobber offers a free house cleaning cost calculator (visit type, square feet, bedrooms, bathrooms, add-ons) that outputs a price range.
Jobber gives a free cleaning estimate template as PDF and Excel, and its software is free for up to five estimates, jobs and invoices a month.
Housecall Pro offers free home cleaning price, bid, labor, margin and markup calculators and a free estimate template.
ShiftFlow offers a free, no sign-up house cleaning cost calculator that runs in the browser, plus a separate free quote generator.
